# antigravity-priority v1.0.1

## Release Notes

**This update (v1.0.1) includes:**
- Added one-click "🔄 Reset to Default" feature to remove the `"priority"` field from physical credential documents, restoring CPA's native unset priority state.
- Relocated default state cache persistence to CPA standard mounted data directory (`data/antigravity-priority-cache.json`) with startup initialization, so data survives container restarts.
- Refined embedded dashboard styles to seamlessly adapt across all 3 official CPA themes (Default Parchment, Dark, and Light).
- Optimized visual ConfigFields in CPA plugin manager with native switch toggles, dropdowns, number inputs, and English-first bilingual descriptions.
- Adjusted Toast notifications positioning and prevented redundant logs or empty modal popups when no credentials exist.
- Enhanced YAML parser robustness when handling host-level config lists during registration.
